title: Rav Ada son of Rav Ika

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin 84a; see also the entry Rav Idi son of Rav Ika.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Gittin 84a. The matching statement by Rav Ada son of Rav Ika appears in the William Davidson digital text of Gittin 84b; both locators are retained.

The named William Davidson Gittin 84b paragraph explicitly names Rav Ada son of Rav Ika. Hyman’s 84a and the existing note’s 84b remain alongside each other. The Rav Idi son of Rav Ika cross-reference is translated as supplied; it is not a newly bound target or proof of identity. No further law from the selected paragraph is imported.
